integration_removed.description:
The Zengge integration has been removed from __HA_KEEP__. Support for Zengge lights is provided by the `led_ble` integration.

To resolve this issue, please remove the (now defunct) `zengge` light configuration from your __HA_KEEP__ configuration and [configure the `led_ble` integration]({led_ble_url}).
integration_removed.title: The Zengge integration has been removed
